Bindings for hb-aat-layout.h (HarfBuzz 14.2.1).

Feature types are a Nim enum (values unique). Selector values repeat across feature types, so selectors are plain constants over hb_aat_layout_feature_selector_t (= cuint). Generated enum/const values; procs hand-written below.
